questions.prompt: Which of these metals does a magnet pick up?
questions.fact: Only a handful of metals are strongly magnetic at room temperature. A drinks can is aluminium, so a magnet slides off it.

questions.prompt: Which of these superheroes are from Marvel?
questions.fact: Batman, Aquaman and The Flash belong to DC, Marvel's great rival.

questions.prompt: What is the pH of pure water?
questions.fact: Seven, right in the middle of the scale. Lower is acid and higher is alkaline.

questions.prompt: How many provinces does Canada have?
questions.fact: Ten provinces and three territories, and the territories cover about 40% of the country.

questions.prompt: Who designed the Sagrada Família in Barcelona?
questions.hint: He was from Catalonia and loved curves drawn from nature.
questions.fact: Building began in 1882, and Antoni Gaudí worked on it for over 40 years.

questions.prompt: What is a group of lions called?
questions.hint: It is also a word for feeling good about yourself.
questions.fact: The lionesses in a pride do most of the hunting, and they are usually all related.
